# Petteri Helttula

> Portfolio of Petteri Helttula, a Helsinki-based product designer and design engineer.

Petteri works across product design, UX/UI, AI, code, data and interactive product experiments. The portfolio includes selected case studies, work-in-progress projects, personal experiments and background on his design approach.

## Main site

- [Portfolio](https://petu.design/): The canonical portfolio homepage and entry point to all work.
- [About](https://petu.design/#about): Background, interests and the path into product design.
- [Selected work](https://petu.design/#work): Product design projects and experiments.
- [Resume](https://petu.design/#resume): Experience, focus areas and contact details.

## Selected projects

- [Peluutin](https://petu.design/peluutin/): Product design and development for junior football match-day coaching and training exercises.
- [Helsinki Sports Map](https://petu.design/helsinki-sports-map/): Work-in-progress sports discovery product using public data, a custom API and a reusable venue data pipeline.
- [KorisLab](https://petu.design/korislab/): Work-in-progress basketball analysis product for Finland's men's and women's Korisliiga, with season data from 2024–25 onward.
- [Brio](https://petu.design/brio/): Digital wellbeing concept using pose tracking to encourage short movement breaks while scrolling.
- [S-hävikki](https://petu.design/s-havikki/): Service design project exploring retail food waste reduction and near-expiry checks.
- [Tahti](https://petu.design/tahti/): Interaction design project that presents selected text one word at a time at a controlled pace.

## Side projects

- [Spire Coach Mod](https://petu.design/spire-coach-mod/): Work-in-progress game coaching experiment exploring how gameplay data can become useful feedback without taking decisions away from the player.
